name: Talk To PC – Voice Widget
author: yinon11

sections.description:
Talk to PC with your website using the Talk To PC Voice Widget — an AI-powered voice assistant for WordPress.

Visitors can speak naturally with your site and get real-time answers based on your actual content.
No coding, no training, no complex setup.

Try it live before installing
Live demo: https://talktopc.com/demos/agent_1900570ad

🚀 Quick Setup (2 Minutes)

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Click Connect to Talk To PC and authorize
  3. Done — your voice agent is created automatically

After connection, the plugin scans your pages, posts, and products to generate an initial AI prompt tailored to your website.

Initial setup may take 30–60 seconds, depending on site size. This is normal.

✨ Features

  • One-Click Setup – Secure OAuth connection with automatic AI agent creation
  • Free Monthly Allowance – Includes 30 minutes (0.5 hour) of voice conversations per month with limited features
  • 40+ Languages – English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, Arabic, German, Chinese, and more
  • Voice & Text – Visitors can speak or type naturally
  • AI-Generated Prompt – Built automatically from your site content
  • Fully Customizable – Colors, logo, text, size, and widget position
  • WooCommerce Ready – Products, prices, and availability included
  • Mobile Friendly – Optimized for desktop and mobile devices
  • Low Latency – Fast responses for natural conversations

🎯 Use Cases

  • Customer support automation
  • FAQ handling
  • Product discovery and sales assistance
  • Appointment scheduling
  • Lead qualification

🔒 Security & Privacy

  • Secure OAuth 2.0 connection
  • No passwords stored
  • One-time authorization tokens
  • Encrypted HTTPS communication

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Search for Talk To PC Voice Widget
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Open Talk To PC from the admin menu
  5. Click Connect to Talk To PC
  6. Click Authorize

Your AI voice agent will be generated automatically.
sections.faq:
Is there a free version?

Yes. Talk To PC includes a free monthly allowance of 30 minutes (0.5 hour) of voice conversations with limited features.
You can upgrade at any time if you need more usage or advanced options.

How does the AI know my website content?

After you connect, the plugin scans your pages, posts, and products to build a knowledge base.
You can regenerate the prompt at any time from the settings.

What languages are supported?

Over 40 languages, including English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and more.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Products, prices, and descriptions are automatically included.
